draft.prompt: Create a large square, front-facing premium gothic action-RPG memorial panel with crisp blackened bronze, restrained oxblood enamel, a quiet charcoal center, complete symmetric corners, and a perfectly flat #00ff00 chroma-key exterior. Keep the central 68% clear, make the edges 9-slice aware, and include no text, logo, watermark, perspective, blur, or cast shadow.

modalPlate.prompt: Recompose the approved square frame as a genuinely authored landscape 3:2 modal plate. Preserve the black iron, aged bronze, restrained oxblood, sharp engraving, and dense charcoal center texture. Keep all corners visible, central 72% clear, outside perfectly uniform #00ff00, and do not stretch the square reference. No text, logo, watermark, character, perspective, blur, or external shadow.

modularFrame.prompt: Convert the approved square frame into a true modular 9-slice border: remove all midpoint crests, jewels, and the entire interior plate; reconnect every edge as a straight continuous low-detail engraved rail; retain only four complete decorated corners; make every non-frame pixel perfectly uniform #00ff00. Preserve material style and crisp detail. No text, logo, watermark, perspective, blur, interior fill, or outside shadow.
